about: Part of the graph of Storm Charles, Lisbon: Wednesday 11 November 2026: every Dataset (a file of this site's data), with the edges that touch it (produced-by, and cites where a dataset is cited). Same shape as data/graph/storm.json; edges here point to nodes there. Built by tools/graph-build.mjs. Not a warning service: follow IPMA and ANEPC.
origin_note: origin is file#pointer, relative to origin_base; a leading / means relative to the repository root. An edge's id is rel:from>to.
